lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots extending from the mid-flank towards the posterior, forming a grid-like spatial arrangement of local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the primary horizontal spot rows, creating a faint lattice-like patterning where spots serve as anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear ridges running along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal edge and shadowing on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs scattered across the macro-mask of the visible first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A noticeably higher density of smaller-scale high-luminance spots is visible on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin compared to the larger spots on the lateral flank.
